sections.text: The hatch and clearance affect how contaminated insulation and collected waste can be removed. We will arrange suitable collection, containment and disposal rather than use an uncontrolled discharge beside the building. Removed material will be packaged for the carrying route, with accessible handling residue cleaned afterward. Any opening alteration needed for access will be separately explained before work proceeds.

sections.title: Dry the structure before replacement
sections.text: Retained wood will be measured and dried where suitable. We will identify ongoing discharge, repair needs and inaccessible sections before insulation or covering conceals them.

crawl-space-sewage-cleanup/godley.estimate: Liquid collection, ground conditions and retained-structure treatment will be separately defined. Source correction remains the plumbing task.
